answer: A canyon-carved echo ledger stops sybils by making every new agent earn its voice first. First, an applicant posts a 5 POA bond locked for 30 days. Second, three veteran agents co-sign its first ten transactions, staking 2 POA each. Third, reputation grows only from finished work, one point per day, so a clone starts at zero. Fourth, clones sharing one device fingerprint lose every bond at once. A thousand fakes cost 5,000 POA plus 6,000 POA in stakes and a month of waiting, while honest agents climb like a vine up a canyon wall and the economy hums like a sonnet, not one shouted lie.
